definitions.explanation: Any substance or device capable of producing a violent explosion, including bombs, grenades, and industrial blasting agents.

examples.japanese: {爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}を{発見|はっけん}した。
{空港|くうこう}では{爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}の{持|も}ち{込|こ}みが{固|かた}く{禁|きん}じられている。
examples.english: Bringing explosives into the airport is strictly forbidden.

examples.japanese: {警察|けいさつ}は{駅構内|えきこうない}に{置|お}き{去|ざ}りにされた{不審|ふしん}な{荷物|にもつ}を、{爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}{処理|しょり}{班|はん}を{呼|よ}んで{調|しら}べた。
examples.english: Police called in a bomb-disposal unit to examine the suspicious package left in the station.

notes:
Compound of {爆発|ばくはつ} (explosion) + {物|ぶつ} (thing, object). Common in legal, police, and security contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}{処理|しょり}{班|はん}: bomb-disposal squad
- {爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}{探知|たんち}{犬|けん}: explosives-detection dog
- {爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}{取締法|とりしまりほう}: Explosives Control Act
- {爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}を{仕掛|しか}ける: to plant an explosive device
- {爆発物|ばくはつぶつ}を{発見|はっけん}する: to discover explosives

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {爆弾|ばくだん}: bomb — a specific finished device, not the broader category
- {火薬|かやく}: gunpowder — explosive powder used in firearms or fireworks
- {危険物|きけんぶつ}: hazardous materials — a broader legal category including flammables, poisons, and explosives
